notes.title: Pure fan among saloons and prairies with 60% discount
notes.notes:
The classic cowboy theme from westerns is playing in the background...
A hoarse voiceover enters with a characteristic accent 🤠

"You don't seem to be local, man? Well, you know, our town is still a hole. Local punks are completely unbelted, honest people have no life with all these thugs. What to do, how to cope with them - we do not know. Can you tell me something? After all, it's your job now. What do you mean they didn't tell you? You're the new sheriff now, mate. Congratulations! Although you know what? I do not congratulate you even a bit... "

Want to continue the story? Well, High Noon VR shooter with 60% discount for all winter holidays!

notes.title: High Noon VR — Launch Trailer
notes.notes:
Russian publisher Buka Entertainment announced the worldwide release of High Noon VR, a brand new shooter for virtual reality headsets!
The game is already available on Steam and it’s fully compatible with HTC Vive and Oculus Rift.  

High Noon VR – the exciting and funny VR shooter developed by Russia based Octobox Interactive. Player assumes the role of a new sheriff of the small town isolated somewhere in the Wild West. Things are not doing that well there because of the hordes of bloodthirsty outlaws all over the neighborhood. Now it’s time to show them who’s the Law here now. Put on your favorite spurred boots, lock and load your faithful Colt – this town awaits its savior!

https://youtu.be/2WHZavDNfX0
